title: Dashboard (Practice Landing)
description: Dashboard (Practice Landing) documentation for Practice Admin.
overview: This guide covers dashboard (practice landing) workflows for Practice Admin.

subtasks.title: Sign in and land on the assigned practice
subtasks.purpose: Open the practice dashboard scoped to the Practice Admin’s single assigned practice.

steps.title: Sign In as Practice Admin
steps.description: Sign in with Practice Admin credentials at the eVitals login page.

steps.title: Confirm Welcome Toast
steps.description: A green welcome toast (“Welcome back, practice admin!”) confirms the role.

steps.title: Review Enrollment Chips
steps.description: The practice name and enrolment chips (e.g. 12 CCM, 30 RPM) appear at the top of the page.

steps.title: Switch Between Tabs
steps.description: Use the tab strip to switch between Practice, Admins, Providers, Caregivers, Patients, System Caregivers, RPM, Schedule & Targets and Import Patients.

steps.title: Use Sidebar Navigation
steps.description: Use the left sidebar (Dashboard, Patient Mgmt, Care Mgmt, Calendar, Messages, Settings) to leave the practice landing. Notes A Practice Admin sees exactly one practice — the practice they were provisioned against — so there is no Practice List to pick from. The red dot on sidebar icons signals unread alerts for that module. Task 7.2 — Practice Tab
